Package com.sca4d.core.spring.config

Class CoreJacksonAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.spring.config.CoreJacksonAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(before=org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.jackson.JacksonAutoConfiguration.class) @ConditionalOnClass(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper.class) public class CoreJacksonAutoConfiguration extends Object
配置 Spring Boot HTTP JSON 格式和脚手架内部稳定 JSON 映射器。
